plans.idea: Classic story stack on a shared left edge: brand row (logo left, NEW VIDEO badge right) at the top, a wide text block with a large headline, then the bottle filling the lower half as a big square so the page has no dead zone.
Product-first poster: centred logo masthead, a big bottle in the upper half, then the NEW VIDEO badge sitting directly above the headline as its kicker, with the text block anchoring the lower third.

Symmetric centred column: badge as a tag at top centre, headline and subhead below it, bottle centred in the middle, and the logo as a brand sign-off at the bottom so the eye runs headline, product, brand.
